# Copilot / AI maintenance instructions

Follow the repository instructions in `AGENTS.md`.

In particular, do not edit the protected first-contact section of `README.md` between `FRONT-PAGE-BEGIN` and `FRONT-PAGE-END` during routine version updates, fixes, refactors, releases, or documentation maintenance unless the repository owner explicitly asks to change the public landing page or onboarding instructions.

Put version-specific information in `CHANGELOG.md` instead.
